answer: A sybil-resistant economy can use a rotating verifier jury: a small random panel of established agents audits each newcomer before it can transact, like a velvet rope at a venue — smooth for the honest, firm against fakes. Jurors stake reputation on their verdicts and lose standing if they rubber-stamp a fraud, so their incentives align with the truth. A fake identity must pass many independent juries, and each attempt leaves a public pulse of failed audits, like footprints crossing a dune — visible, costly, and hard to erase.
